requirement_summary: Limit system access to authorized users, processes acting for users, and devices
Limit users to the types of transactions and functions they are permitted to run
Verify and control or limit connections to and use of external systems
Control information posted or processed on publicly accessible systems
Identify system users, processes acting for users, and devices
Authenticate users, processes and devices before allowing access
Sanitize or destroy media containing FCI before disposal or reuse
Limit physical access to systems, equipment and operating environments to authorized people
Escort and monitor visitors, keep physical access logs, control physical access devices
Monitor control and protect communications at external and key internal boundaries
Put publicly accessible system components in subnetworks separated from internal networks
Identify, report and correct system flaws in a timely manner
Protect against malicious code at appropriate locations
Update malicious code protection when new releases are available
Run periodic scans and real-time scans of files from external sources
